firstPartyChecks.observation: Official Vigo page says parcel plans and cadastral information are obtained directly from the Catastro office.
National Catastro publishes a cadastral-parcel WFS endpoint; endpoint publication is not evidence of a successful feature read.
Official Catastro office page describes territorial registration and cartography services.

firstPartyCache.observation: Original national INSPIRE page advertises cadastral-parcel WFS.
Original WFS GetCapabilities body is an HTML error page saying the request cannot be processed.
Versioned WFS GetCapabilities returns the same HTML error body.
WMS GetCapabilities returns the same HTML error body.

custody.assessment: Vigo/Catastro custody is grounded. Published WFS documentation exists, but the inspected capability requests returned HTTP 400 error HTML and no parcel schema or geometry.

scopeCaveat: No verified public native-ID parcel polygon response. Access errors, login controls or an unavailable viewer do not establish citywide cadastral absence.
